name: Dirty air flow meter - P0101 and a substitute model
description: Oil mist on the hot film makes the air flow meter read 40 % low. Like a vacuum leak, the mixture goes lean and the trims climb - but here the ECM's speed-density model disagrees with the meter: P0101. The ECM stops trusting the sensor, fuels from the model, and the trims come back.

steps.note: 1. PID 10: about 2.2 g/s at warm idle
2. The hot film is contaminated: it reads 60 % of the real air flow
Too little fuel for the real air: lean, the short-term trim climbs
3. P0101: measured flow 40 % below the model from rpm and throttle
No P0171 yet - the plausibility check was faster
4. The ECM now fuels from the model (substitute value) ...
DID 0x1011: the meter's voltage - compare with the sensor table in the car view
Reset the trims learned while the meter was wrong
